obituaries.full_text:
Margaret Harmon Banks of Milton died of heart failure Tuesday, Sept. 27, 2005, 
  in Bayhealth-MilfordMemorialHospital, Milford. She was 104.

She is survived by three sons, Nolan Banks and Alton Harmon, both of Milton, 
  and Milton Banks of Rochester, N.Y.; three daughters, Pearl Cirwithian of Milton, 
  Joyce Jones of Ellendale and Marie Ealy of Philadelphia; three sons-in-law; 
  two daughters-in-law; grandchildren; great-grandchildren; great-great-grandchildren; 
  great-great-great-grandchildren; and a host of other family and friends.

Services will be noon Monday in BethelA.M.E.Church, Milton, where friends may 
  call two hours earlier. Burial will be in BethelA.M.E.Cemetery. Arrangements by Young's Funeral Home, 
  Milford
